messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — quick heads up, ACME's POC started failing after ~1h with 401s. They used the trial API key we gave them. Can someone help debug?

jeff_support: Thanks — can you paste a failing request/response (headers + x-request-id) and approximate time?

alex_sales: sure — snippet from their logs (sanitized):
POST /v1/generate  200ms
Authorization: Bearer sk_trial_abc123
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
Response 401: {"error":"invalid_signature","message":"kid mismatch"}

ingrid_eng: kid mismatch usually means the signing key id in the token doesn't match the JWKS our auth service is serving. Did they rotate the key or are they caching a stale JWKS?

maria_se: they said they spun up a short-lived service that auto-rotates keys every 30m for dev. Could be that. Also: are they mixing org-scoped keys vs trial account keys?

jeff_support: Can you ask them to curl the JWKS endpoint and show the current keys + kid used in the JWT? Example: 
curl -sS https://auth.redwood.example/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'

alex_sales: sent that back. They reported the kid in the JWT = "v2-rotate-07" but JWKS has "v2-rotate-08".

ingrid_eng: yep that's the problem. Two remediation paths: 1) update the client to fetch JWKS on retry or respect cache-control on the JWKS response, 2) issue a new static API key for the POC that doesn't rotate, or 3) have us create a short-lived backward-compatible rotation alias (we can patch auth service for them for the duration).

sam_re: adding reliability note — intermittent 401s during rotation are expected if clients cache keys aggressively. For POC we'd recommend non-rotating key or TTL aligned with client poll. If they need production-grade rotation, Dedicated/Private lets you manage key lifecycle via KMS/HSM (seamless rotations).

alex_sales: customer asked if issuing a new key will affect billing or quotas.

maria_se: no change to pricing — keys map to org/project usage. But if they move to Dedicated for stability that has reserved capacity pricing. I'll follow up with a pricing note.

jeff_support: temporary workaround: create a one-off API key from Console -> API Keys -> Create, set name "acme-poc-static", give project scope, and share. That solved similar POCs.

alex_sales: I created a static key and they replaced it. Confirmed 200s now for past 15m. Customer still wants to understand root cause for their infra.

ingrid_eng: we'll open a short postmortem doc for them: root cause = client-side JWKS cache + automated rotation. Action items: add cache-control on JWKS (ENG-2143), add sample client snippet to SDK showing exponential backoff + jwks refresh (DEVEX-802), and ops-runbook note for sales POCs (SALES-POC-KEYS).

devops-bot: Deploy pipeline #deploy-auth-ops ran: PATCH jwks-cache-header  -> succeeded (sha: ab12cd).

jeff_support: Also flagged security questionnaire item: they asked if Redwood stores signing keys — answer: Hosted stores private signing keys in a managed KMS; Private customers manage their own KMS/HSM. I'll paste the standard sec answer.

alex_sales: perfect. Customer happy for now. I'll schedule a technical follow-up with ACME to show the console key rotation controls and share the pricing note. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_se: looping in me for pricing follow-up. I'll send ACME a short summary + Dedicated options and SLA doc.

sam_re: recommend adding a KB entry: "POC 401s during key rotations" under support docs. I'll create it after ENG-2143 lands.

alex_sales: closing the swarm. Marking this resolved for the thread.
